author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಮುಂದೆಬರೊ ಘಟನೆಗಳ ಊಹಿಪುದು ಕಠಿಣವಹು
ಹಿಂದಾದ ವಿಷಯಗಳೆ ಮನವ ಹಿಡಿಯುವವು
ಸಂದಿರುವ ಬಾಳುವೆಯ ಅಳೆದು ತೂಗುತ ನಡೆಯೆ
ಬಂದ ಋಣ ತೀರಿಸುವೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: It is hard to guess what the future holds;
it is past events that grip the mind;
if you walk weighing and measuring the life you have lived,
you will repay the debts you came with, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: We cannot know the future, and the past holds us back. Reflect honestly on the life lived so far, and fulfil the obligations (ṛṇa) we were born with.
